title: Internet Archive: OCR misreadings
description: Takes the Wikipedia typo hunter's misspellings that a scanner made rather than a typist (rn for m, cl for d, li for h, the long s read as f, dropped ligatures), searches the Internet Archive's full text for them, and reads the OCR of the worst-scanned texts, a few MB at most each, for non-words that look-alike letters turn into real words. Those that recur across texts go to a results file and the App Hub's Social page as candidates for GGCMS's misspelling lists, for a person to confirm; nothing is added to any list automatically.
